Value.Name: Just for Today
Value.Description:
Al-Anon Is a peer support group for adults who share their experience, strength and hope applying the Al-Anon principles to the effects related to a problem drinker. It is not therapy and is not led by counselor however, this support network does complement professional treatment.  

No Advance notification or written referral is necessary to attend and now and on royalty meeting. Anyone affected by someone else's drinking is welcome.

There are no dues or fees. Groups are self-supporting through voluntary contributions by its members.

Anonymity is an important principle of these programs.  The degree of anonymity a member chooses (First game, psuedonym, full name) Is entirely up to you.  However, everything that is said in our meetings and member to member, must be held in confidence.

We encourage you to try our program. We believe alcoholism is a family disease and that the family situation is bound to improve as the Al-Anon/Alateen ideas are applied and problems lose their power to dominate our thoughts and lives.

Value.Name: Adult Watercolor Course - Weekends at Fan Fine Art Studio
Value.Description:
If you’re looking for a calm, creative way to spend your weekend afternoon in Toronto, Fan Fine Art Studio in Scarborough offers an ongoing adult watercolor painting program in a small, private studio setting.

Classes take place on **weekend afternoons**, allowing participants to develop watercolor skills through consistent, hands-on practice. With a maximum of five students per session, the class focuses on essential techniques such as color mixing, brush control, layering, and composition, with individualized guidance throughout.

Rather than a one-time workshop, this ongoing program encourages steady artistic growth over time, giving participants the space to explore watercolor painting at a comfortable pace and take home completed artwork each week.

Full details, current schedule, and registration information are available on the studio’s website.

Value.Name: Coach-Consultant in-Residence
Value.Description: Description Sometimes you just need good advice, not a whole program.   We have a passion for small business! As part of our giveback to the Barrie Chamber and members, you can book a 30 to 45 minute private coaching-consulting session to untangle a challenge or identify next steps on an opportunity that is happening in your business. You will meet with our senior business coach Cher Cunningham and CFO and Management Consultant Jim Pelot for a private session - held at our Incubator business OfficeInc! on Cedar Pointe Drive. We have the coffee on! What can I use this session for? Questions we receive \(along with the follow up question - why hasn't anyone told me this before?\) : My accountant says "put a hold co on top of my op co" is that right? Can I afford to hire this amazing potential employee? How can I find time to work ON my business? Should I offer my employees equity? What is the most vital need of my business right now? How can I introduce myself more powerfully at networking events? How do I get over my fear of sales? How can I get ready for this new opportunity? How do I get more engagement in my employees? How can I stop paying so much tax? How do I clean up this bottleneck in my company? Should I take a salary, a dividend, or both? How can my business stand out? get better clients? How do I get a personal pension plan through my company? Should my company buy real estate? and many more. Bring your burning questions. Stepping out of your business and getting a new perspective can get your challenge solved and your bottleneck unstuck. If all you really need is great advice and support from experienced business people... let's do that!

We encourage you to try our program. We believe alcoholism is a family disease and that the family situation is bound to improve as the Al-Anon/Alateen ideas are applied and problems lose their power to dominate our thoughts and lives.

If you’re looking for a calm, creative way to spend your weekend afternoon in Toronto, Fan Fine Art Studio in Scarborough offers an ongoing adult watercolor painting program in a small, private studio setting.

Classes take place on **weekend afternoons**, allowing participants to develop watercolor skills through consistent, hands-on practice.
